mapper.select: SELECT id,base_version,state,revision,created_by,created_at,reviewed_by,reviewed_at,review_note,published_version FROM knowledge_proposals WHERE shop_id=#{shop} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT * FROM knowledge_proposals WHERE shop_id=#{shop} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_proposal_revisions (proposal_id,revision,base_version,snapshot,state,actor,created_at,review_note,published_version) SELECT id,revision,base_version,snapshot,state,#{actor},#{at},review_note,published_version FROM knowledge_proposals WHERE shop_id=#{shop} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT h.revision,h.state,h.actor,h.created_at,h.review_note,h.base_version,h.published_version FROM knowledge_proposal_revisions h JOIN knowledge_proposals p ON p.id=h.proposal_id WHERE p.shop_id=#{shop} AND p.id=#{id} ORDER BY h.revision DESC
SELECT snapshot FROM knowledge_versions WHERE shop_id=#{shop} AND id=#{version}
